verdict.rationale: Kong provides decK, an official CLI specifically built for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps), enabling declarative config management and sync from CI/CD, with hands-on confirmation the CLI installs and runs; docs also show Admin API/declarative config support and Kubernetes-native deployment. Missing for 10: a first-party documented CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) showing end-to-end diff/sync in practice.
